review_scope: Documentation/existing-evidence review only. No designs run or modified, no repository writes/push. Source checkout documentation can be concurrently changed by integrating chat; checks pin the captured snapshots rather than claim the whole checkout is unchanged.
known_required_log_gap: 12 unreadable reviewer instruction bodies (same sender/recipient exchanges), plus two originally truncated tool outputs; unrelated older records do not substitute for those exact prompts.
grading_boundary: Presence of four deliverable types is distinct from complete qualification, maximum scores or instructor acceptance.
